lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਭਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sobhaa surat suhaavanee jin har setee chit laaiaa ||2||
lines.translation: Beautiful and sublime is the glory and the understanding of those who focus their consciousness on the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 2 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Second Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਖੀ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਵੇਖਣਾ ਵਿਣੁ ਕੰਨਾ ਸੁਨਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: akhee baajhahu vekhanaa vin ka(n)naa sunanaa ||
lines.translation: To see without eyes; to hear without ears;

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੈਰਾ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਚਲਣਾ ਵਿਣੁ ਹਥਾ ਕਰਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: pairaa baajhahu chalanaa vin hathaa karanaa ||
lines.translation: to walk without feet; to work without hands;

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਭੈ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਬੋਲਣਾ ਇਉ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeebhai baajhahu bolanaa iu jeevat maranaa ||
lines.translation: to speak without a tongue-like this, one remains dead while yet alive.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ਕੈ ਤਉ ਖਸਮੈ ਮਿਲਣਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak hukam pachhaan kai tau khasamai milanaa ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, recognize the Hukam of the Lord's Command, and merge with your Lord and Master. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 2 ||
lines.translation: Second Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਿਸੈ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਸਾਉ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: disai suneeai jaaneeai saau na paaiaa jaai ||
lines.translation: He is seen, heard and known, but His subtle essence is not obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੁਹਲਾ ਟੁੰਡਾ ਅੰਧੁਲਾ ਕਿਉ ਗਲਿ ਲਗੈ ਧਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ruhalaa tu(n)daa a(n)dhulaa kiu gal lagai dhaai ||
lines.translation: How can the lame, armless and blind person run to embrace the Lord?

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਕਰ ਭਾਵ ਕੇ ਲੋਇਣ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhai ke charan kar bhaav ke loin surat karei ||
lines.translation: Let the Fear of God be your feet, and let His Love be your hands; let His Understanding be your eyes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਿਆਣੀਏ ਇਵ ਕੰਤ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kahai siaaneee iv ka(n)t milaavaa hoi ||2||
lines.translation: Says Nanak, in this way, O wise soul-bride, you shall be united with your Husband Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤੂੰ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਤੁਧੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa sadaa too(n) ek hai tudh doojaa khel rachaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Forever and ever, You are the only One; You set the play of duality in motion.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ ਲੋਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੰਤਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: haumai garab upaai kai lobh a(n)tar ja(n)taa paaiaa ||
lines.translation: You created egotism and arrogant pride, and You placed greed within our beings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਖੁ ਤੂ ਸਭ ਕਰੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: jiu bhaavai tiu rakh too sabh kare teraa karaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Keep me as it pleases Your Will; everyone acts as You cause them to act.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਨਾ ਬਖਸਹਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਤੁਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikanaa bakhasahi mel laihi guramatee tudhai laaiaa ||
lines.translation: Some are forgiven, and merge with You; through the Guru's Teachings, we are joined to You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਖੜੇ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੇਰੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik khaRe karahi teree chaakaree vin naavai hor na bhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Some stand and serve You; without the Name, nothing else pleases them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਰੁ ਕਾਰ ਵੇਕਾਰ ਹੈ ਇਕਿ ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hor kaar vekaar hai ik sachee kaarai laaiaa ||
lines.translation: Any other task would be worthless to them-You have enjoined them to Your True Service.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੁਤੁ ਕਲਤੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਹੈ ਇਕਿ ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਰਹੇ ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: put kalat kuta(n)b hai ik alipat rahe jo tudh bhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: In the midst of children, spouse and relations, some still remain detached; they are pleasing to Your Will.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਹਿ ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ohi a(n)darahu baaharahu niramale sachai naai samaaiaa ||3||
lines.translation: Inwardly and outwardly, they are pure, and they are absorbed in the True Name. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਇਨੇ ਕੈ ਪਰਬਤਿ ਗੁਫਾ ਕਰੀ ਕੈ ਪਾਣੀ ਪਇਆਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: suine kai parabat guphaa karee kai paanee paiaal ||
lines.translation: I may make a cave, in a mountain of gold, or in the water of the nether regions;

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਕੈ ਆਕਾਸੀ ਉਰਧਿ ਰਹਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kai vich dharatee kai aakaasee uradh rahaa sir bhaar ||
lines.translation: I may remain standing on my head, upside-down, on the earth or up in the sky;

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੁਰੁ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਕਪੜੁ ਪਹਿਰਾ ਧੋਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਕਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: pur kar kaaiaa kapaR pahiraa dhovaa sadaa kaar ||
lines.translation: I may totally cover my body with clothes, and wash them continually;

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਗਾ ਰਤਾ ਪੀਅਲਾ ਕਾਲਾ ਬੇਦਾ ਕਰੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: bagaa rataa peealaa kaalaa bedaa karee pukaar ||
lines.translation: I may shout out loud, the white, red, yellow and black Vedas;

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਕੁਚੀਲੁ ਰਹਾ ਮਲੁ ਧਾਰੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: hoi kucheel rahaa mal dhaaree duramat mat vikaar ||
lines.translation: I may even live in dirt and filth. And yet, all this is just a product of evil-mindedness, and intellectual corruption.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਹਉ ਨਾ ਮੈ ਨਾ ਹਉ ਹੋਵਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naa hau naa mai naa hau hovaa naanak sabad veechaar ||1||
lines.translation: I was not, I am not, and I will never be anything at all! O Nanak, I dwell only on the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਸਤ੍ਰ ਪਖਾਲਿ ਪਖਾਲੇ ਕਾਇਆ ਆਪੇ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: vasatr pakhaal pakhaale kaaiaa aape sa(n)jam hovai ||
lines.translation: They wash their clothes, and scrub their bodies, and try to practice self-discipline.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਲਗੀ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਣੈ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar mail lagee nahee jaanai baaharahu mal mal dhovai ||
lines.translation: But they are not aware of the filth staining their inner being, while they try and try to wash off the outer dirt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧਾ ਭੂਲਿ ਪਇਆ ਜਮ ਜਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dhaa bhool paiaa jam jaale ||
lines.translation: The blind go astray, caught by the noose of Death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਸਤੁ ਪਰਾਈ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਘਾਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vasat paraaee apunee kar jaanai haumai vich dukh ghaale ||
lines.translation: They see other people's property as their own, and in egotism, they suffer in pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਤੁਟੈ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh haumai tutai taa har har naam dhiaavai ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the egotism of the Gurmukhs is broken, and then, they meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇ ਨਾਮੋ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਖਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naam jape naamo aaraadhe naame sukh samaavai ||2||
lines.translation: They chant the Naam, meditate on the Naam, and through the Naam, they are absorbed in peace. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਵੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pavaRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਹੰਸਿ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaiaa ha(n)s sa(n)jog mel milaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Destiny has brought together and united the body and the soul-swan.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਕੀਆ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin hee keeaa vijog jin upaaiaa ||
lines.translation: He who created them, also separates them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖੁ ਭੋਗੇ ਭੋਗੁ ਦੁਖ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: moorakh bhoge bhog dukh sabaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The fools enjoy their pleasures; they must also endure all their pains.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਹੁ ਉਠੇ ਰੋਗ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukhahu uthe rog paap kamaaiaa ||
lines.translation: From pleasures, arise diseases and the commission of sins.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਖਹੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਖਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: harakhahu sog vijog upaai khapaaiaa ||
lines.translation: From sinful pleasures come sorrow, separation, birth and death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੂਰਖ ਗਣਤ ਗਣਾਇ ਝਗੜਾ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: moorakh ganat ganaai jhagaRaa paaiaa ||
lines.translation: The fools try to account for their misdeeds, and argue uselessly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਥਿ ਨਿਬੇੜੁ ਝਗੜੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur hath nibeR jhagaR chukaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The judgement is in the Hands of the True Guru, who puts an end to the argument.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਗੁ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: karataa kare s hog na chalai chalaaiaa ||4||
lines.translation: Whatever the Creator does, comes to pass. It cannot be changed by anyone's efforts. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਮੁਰਦਾਰੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooR bol muradaar khaai ||
lines.translation: Telling lies, they eat dead bodies.
